aesthetic-dentistry.description: Enhance your smile with our cosmetic dental treatments.

orthodontics.name: Orthodontics
orthodontics.description: Achieve a straighter smile and better oral health with our orthodontic solutions.

restorative-dentistry.name: Restorative Dentistry
restorative-dentistry.description: Restore the health and function of your teeth with our restorative treatments.

oral-surgery.name: Oral Surgery
oral-surgery.description: Expert surgical care for complex dental issues.

pediatric-dentistry.name: Pediatric Dentistry
pediatric-dentistry.description: Gentle and specialized dental care for our youngest patients.

dental-summary.name: Comprehensive Dental Services
dental-summary.description: From aesthetic enhancements to complex surgical procedures, our dental experts provide a full spectrum of care to ensure your oral health and perfect your smile. Explore our wide range of dental specialties.

op-hunde.name: Nose Reshaping (Rhinoplasty)
op-hunde.description: A surgical procedure to reshape the nose for improved appearance and/or function. It can change the size or shape of the nose, adjust the angle between the nose and upper lip, or correct breathing problems.

rim-hunde.name: Nose Tip Reshaping
rim-hunde.description: A focused procedure that specifically refines the shape, size, or projection of the nasal tip, often with less downtime than a full rhinoplasty.

rim-vesheve.name: Ear Reshaping (Otoplasty)
rim-vesheve.description: A surgical procedure to change the size, shape, or position of the ears. It is commonly performed to correct protruding ears or to address ears that have been misshapen by injury.

mbj-flokeve.name: Hair Transplant
mbj-flokeve.description: A surgical technique that moves hair follicles from a part of the body (the donor site) to a bald or balding part of the body (the recipient site). It is primarily used to treat male pattern baldness.

mbj-mjekres.name: Beard Transplant
mbj-mjekres.description: Similar to a hair transplant, this procedure involves transplanting hair follicles to the beard area to increase density, fill in patchy areas, or reshape the beard.

mbj-vetullave.name: Eyebrow Transplant
mbj-vetullave.description: A procedure where hair follicles are transplanted to the eyebrows to create fuller, more defined brows, often for those with naturally thin brows or hair loss.

lift-vetullave.name: Eyebrow Lift (Browplasty)
lift-vetullave.description: A surgical procedure to raise sagging brows and improve the appearance of wrinkles on the forehead and between the eyes, resulting in a more youthful and rested look.

blefaroplastika.name: Eyelid Surgery (Blepharoplasty)
blefaroplastika.description: Surgery to improve the appearance of the eyelids. It can be performed on the upper lids, lower lids, or both to remove sagging skin, excess fat, or bags.

lift-fytyres.name: Face Lift (Rhytidectomy)
lift-fytyres.description: A surgical procedure to improve the visible signs of aging in the face and neck, such as sagging, deep creases, and loose skin.

rim-mjekres.name: Chin Augmentation (Genioplasty)
rim-mjekres.description: A surgical procedure to reshape or enhance the chin, either with an implant or by reshaping the bone, to improve the balance of facial proportions.

lip-reshaping.name: Lip Reshaping & Augmentation
lip-reshaping.description: A cosmetic procedure to improve the appearance of the lips by increasing their fullness, shape, structure, or symmetry, often using dermal fillers.

xanthelasma-plasma-arc.name: Eyelid Deposit Removal (Plasma)
xanthelasma-plasma-arc.description: This is a non-surgical treatment to remove yellow cholesterol spots found on the eyelids. We use a precise plasma device to gently clear these deposits, giving you smoother skin with very little recovery time.

multivitamin-treatment.name: Multivitamin Infusion Facial
multivitamin-treatment.description: A facial treatment that infuses a blend of vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants directly into the skin to nourish, hydrate, and revitalize it, resulting in a more radiant complexion.

eyelids-plasma-arc.name: Non-Surgical Eyelid Lift (Plasma Arc)
eyelids-plasma-arc.description: A non-invasive treatment that uses plasma energy to lift and tighten the skin on the eyelids, reducing the appearance of sagging skin and wrinkles without surgery.

cheekbone-reshaping.name: Cheekbone Contouring (Fillers)
cheekbone-reshaping.description: A non-surgical procedure that uses dermal fillers to enhance and define the cheekbones, restoring volume and creating a more contoured facial structure.

microdermabrasion.name: Microdermabrasion
microdermabrasion.description: A minimally invasive procedure that renews the skin by gently sanding away the thick outer layer, treating sun damage, wrinkles, and other skin concerns.

jawline-contouring.name: Jawline Contouring (Fillers/Threads)
jawline-contouring.description: A non-surgical technique to define and sculpt the jawline using dermal fillers or PDO threads, creating a sharper, more youthful profile.

wrinkle-fillers.name: Dermal Fillers for Wrinkles
wrinkle-fillers.description: Injections of hyaluronic acid or other fillers to plump up wrinkles and fine lines, restoring volume and smoothing the skin's texture for a rejuvenated appearance.

prp-face.name: PRP Facial Rejuvenation
prp-face.description: A procedure that uses your own blood's platelet-rich plasma (PRP), which is injected into the skin to stimulate collagen production and improve skin texture and elasticity.

dark-circles-treatment.name: Under-Eye Dark Circles Treatment
dark-circles-treatment.description: A range of treatments aimed at reducing the appearance of dark circles under the eyes, including fillers, laser therapy, or topical treatments, depending on the underlying cause.

prp-hair.name: PRP Hair Restoration
prp-hair.description: A non-surgical treatment for hair loss where platelet-rich plasma from the patient's blood is injected into the scalp to stimulate hair growth.

white-peeling.name: Chemical Peel
white-peeling.description: A skin-resurfacing treatment that applies a chemical solution to the skin to exfoliate it and eventually peel it off, revealing smoother, less-wrinkled skin.

microneedling.name: Microneedling (Collagen Induction Therapy)
microneedling.description: A procedure that uses fine needles to create tiny punctures in the skin, stimulating collagen and elastin production to improve skin texture and reduce the appearance of scars and wrinkles.

radiofrequency-face.name: Radiofrequency Skin Tightening (Face)
radiofrequency-face.description: A non-surgical method of skin tightening that uses energy to heat the deeper layers of skin, stimulating collagen production and improving skin firmness and texture.

sulcus-filling.name: Nasolabial Fold Fillers
sulcus-filling.description: A non-surgical procedure where dermal fillers are injected into the creases that run from the sides of the nose to the corners of the mouth, softening their appearance.

chin-reshaping.name: Non-Surgical Chin Reshaping (Fillers)
chin-reshaping.description: A procedure that uses injectable fillers to reshape and augment the chin, improving facial balance and creating a stronger chin profile without surgery.

zmadh-gjoksit.name: Breast Augmentation
zmadh-gjoksit.description: A surgical procedure to increase breast size through the placement of breast implants under the breast tissue or muscles.

lift-gjoksit.name: Breast Lift
lift-gjoksit.description: A surgical procedure to raise and reshape the breasts by removing excess skin and tightening the surrounding tissue to restore a more youthful breast profile.

zvog-gjoksit.name: Breast Reduction
zvog-gjoksit.description: A surgical procedure to remove excess breast fat, glandular tissue, and skin to achieve a breast size in proportion with the body and to alleviate the discomfort associated with overly large breasts.

rikonst-gjoksit.name: Breast Reconstruction
rikonst-gjoksit.description: A surgical procedure to restore the shape, appearance, and size of the breast following a mastectomy or lumpectomy.

lift-kraheve.name: Arm Lift
lift-kraheve.description: A surgical procedure to reshape the under portion of the upper arm, from the underarm region to the elbow, by removing excess skin and fat.

rim-barkut.name: Tummy Tuck
rim-barkut.description: A surgical procedure to remove excess skin and fat from the abdomen, creating a smoother, firmer abdominal profile.

liposculptura.name: Liposculpture
liposculptura.description: A form of liposuction that removes excess fat and contours the body to create a more defined, sculpted shape.

rim-vitheve-bbl.name: BBL (Buttock Remodeling)
rim-vitheve-bbl.description: A surgical procedure that transfers fat from other parts of the body to the buttocks to enhance their size, shape, and contour.

labioplastika.name: Labiaplasty
labioplastika.description: A surgical procedure to reshape or reduce the size of the labia for enhanced comfort or aesthetic reasons.

lift-kofsheve.name: Thigh Lift
lift-kofsheve.description: A surgical procedure to reshape the thighs by reducing excess skin and fat, resulting in smoother skin and better-proportioned contours.

gynecomastia.name: Gynecomastia
gynecomastia.description: A surgical procedure to reduce enlarged breast tissue in men, performed through liposuction and/or excision of excess glandular tissue.

cellulite-treatment.name: Cellulite Treatment
cellulite-treatment.description: A variety of procedures aimed at reducing the appearance of cellulite, including laser treatments, radiofrequency, and injectables.

plasma-arc-body.name: Plasma Arc (Body)
plasma-arc-body.description: A non-invasive treatment using plasma energy to tighten loose skin on various parts of the body, improving the appearance of wrinkles and sagging.

carboxytherapy.name: Carboxytherapy
carboxytherapy.description: The therapeutic use of carbon dioxide gas to improve skin elasticity, reduce cellulite and stretch marks, and enhance circulation.

sclerotherapy.name: Sclerotherapy
sclerotherapy.description: A minimally invasive procedure to treat varicose and spider veins, where a solution is injected directly into the vein, causing it to scar, re-route blood, and fade.

lipolysis.name: Lipolysis
lipolysis.description: A non-surgical procedure that uses injections, lasers, or ultrasound to break down and remove fat cells in targeted areas.

laser-hair-removal.name: Laser Hair Removal
laser-hair-removal.description: A cosmetic procedure that uses a concentrated beam of light to remove unwanted hair from various parts of the body.

teeth-whitening.name: Teeth Whitening
teeth-whitening.description: A cosmetic dental procedure that lightens teeth and helps to remove stains and discoloration, creating a brighter, whiter smile.

composite-veneers.name: Composite Veneers
composite-veneers.description: Thin shells of tooth-colored composite material applied to the front surface of teeth to improve their appearance.

emax-veneers.name: E-Max Veneers
emax-veneers.description: High-quality, durable ceramic veneers known for their strength and natural-looking appearance, used to transform smiles.

dental-crowns.name: Dental Crowns
dental-crowns.description: Caps placed over a tooth to restore its shape, size, strength, and appearance.

dental-bridges.name: Dental Bridges
dental-bridges.description: Fixed dental restorations that bridge the gap created by one or more missing teeth.

dentures.name: Dentures
dentures.description: Removable replacements for missing teeth and surrounding tissues.

invisalign.name: Invisalign
invisalign.description: A series of clear, custom-made aligners that gradually straighten teeth over time, serving as an alternative to traditional braces.

fixed-braces.name: Fixed Braces
fixed-braces.description: Traditional orthodontic devices used to correct misaligned teeth and jaws.

removable-appliances.name: Removable Appliances
removable-appliances.description: Orthodontic devices that can be put in and taken out by the patient to correct dental problems.

teeth-cleaning.name: Teeth Cleaning (Tartar Removal)
teeth-cleaning.description: Professional cleaning to remove plaque and tartar from teeth to prevent cavities and gum disease.

dental-fillings.name: Dental Fillings
dental-fillings.description: Materials used to fill and restore teeth damaged by decay, preventing further damage.

root-canal-treatment.name: Root Canal Treatment
root-canal-treatment.description: A dental procedure to remove the infected pulp from inside a tooth to save it and relieve pain.

tooth-extraction.name: Tooth Extraction
tooth-extraction.description: The removal of a tooth from its alveolar socket in the jawbone.

dental-implants.name: Dental Implants
dental-implants.description: Surgical fixtures placed into the jawbone to replace missing teeth and provide a base for fixed or removable replacements.

apical-resection.name: Root End Surgery (Apicoectomy)
apical-resection.description: A surgical procedure to remove the tip of a tooth's root and the surrounding infected tissue.

primary-teeth-care.name: Primary Teeth Care (Milk Teeth)
primary-teeth-care.description: Specialized dental care for children, focusing on maintaining the health of primary teeth to ensure proper development of permanent teeth.

teeth-fluoridation.name: Teeth Fluoridation
teeth-fluoridation.description: The application of fluoride to teeth to strengthen enamel and prevent tooth decay.

dental-sealants.name: Dental Sealants
dental-sealants.description: Thin protective coatings applied to the chewing surfaces of back teeth to prevent cavities.
